meta.note: Invited talks, keynotes, panels and tutorials. Collected here as they are found; nothing is rendered onto the site yet — a talks section with one entry says less than no section at all. tools/build_talks.py and the block on /cv/ follow once there is a set worth showing.

kinds.keynote: Keynote — the organisers built a session around it
kinds.invited: Invited talk — asked to speak by a host institution or event
kinds.tutorial: Tutorial or course taught at an event
kinds.visit: Presentation to a visiting delegation — a different thing from an invited talk, and worth keeping apart: the audience came to see the work rather than to hear a speaker
kinds.own-event: Presentation at an event of his own project — legitimate public activity, but not an invitation from elsewhere

meta.titles: Talk titles stay in the language they were given in, with an English gloss on the English pages — the same rule the site already follows for German degree grades and programme names.

talks.format: short interview on stage, moderated by Dr. Marie-Theres Thiell
talks.title: DIDYMOS-XR: Dynamische digitale Zwillinge in Extended Reality — realisiert am Smart Village Etteln
talks.title_en: DIDYMOS-XR: dynamic digital twins in extended reality, built at the smart village of Etteln
talks.event: Westfälischer Zukunftsdialog, Westfalen e.V. mit der Hochschule Hamm-Lippstadt
talks.note: Invited by Westfalen e.V., hosted at his own university — so not a purely external invitation, and the entry says so. The audience is what makes it worth listing: two mayors, a member of the Bundestag and the Gaia-X managing director, with the Westfälische Agenda 2030 as the occasion. One of two research projects chosen for the programme.

talks.note: Part of the work that produced the DCMS/UKRI report published on 21 July 2023, not a follow-up to it — the workshop came two months earlier. The entry said the opposite while the date was wrong, which is how one wrong field quietly rewrites a story.

talks.note: Keynote of the workshop, not of the DELFI conference — stated that way on purpose. Writing "Keynote, DELFI 2022" would claim the conference keynote, and the difference is exactly what a committee checks first.
